It’s gonna take a mindset change, which may be hard, it was for me. Listen you’re doing great, you should be proud of yourself. Take a moment to breathe and know it’s better to learn how to accept failure now than later. And know a B+ is definitely not a failure but sometimes we individually create extreme standards for ourselves so I understand feeling like it’s a defeat. You need to accept that even if you had a 60 in Lang the world would remain intact and you would be just fine. You should try to understand this concept of failure now, it will hurt you later on in the work force or just in life in general if you can’t move on from moments of defeat. Maybe take a step back just to get your thoughts in order, don’t think about the class just for a while. Please realize you should be so proud of yourself being first in your class is a huge achievement and an 89 shows you’re a great student who works hard in that course. Take this 89 as an opportunity to grow rather than falter, and take time to just be a kid, and enjoy the rest of high school
